import os
base='/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u054/system/state/workspace/programs'
os.makedirs(base,exist_ok=True)
p=base+'/task-5d9f7a8a.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    objs = {}
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            v = grid[r][c]
            if v:
                objs.setdefault(v, []).append((r,c))
    # Reading order of the separated objects, determined by their left edge.
    items = sorted(objs.items(), key=lambda kv: min(c for r,c in kv[1]))
    out = [[0]*w for _ in range(h)]
    top, left = 0, 0
    for i,(color,cells) in enumerate(items):
        minr=min(r for r,c in cells); maxr=max(r for r,c in cells)
        minc=min(c for r,c in cells); maxc=max(c for r,c in cells)
        if i:
            top += prev_h-1
            left += prev_w-1
        for r,c in cells:
            rr=top+r-minr; cc=left+c-minc
            if 0 <= rr < h and 0 <= cc < w:
                out[rr][cc]=color
        prev_h=maxr-minr+1; prev_w=maxc-minc+1
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
exec(compile(code,p,'exec'))
grid=[[0]*10 for _ in range(6)]+[[7]+[0]*9,[7,0,8,8,0,6,0,0,0,0],[7,0,8,8,0,6,0,3,3,0],[7,0,8,8,0,6,0,3,3,0]]
print(transform(grid))
